plugins.deleteConfirm: Delete {{name}}? The gateway stops consulting it immediately.

strategyHints.needsTelemetry: Needs a cache-telemetry source (KV events or an LMCache controller) configured on the target providers. Without one it quietly falls back to least-load.
strategyHints.deploymentWide: Controlled by the deployment-wide adaptive-routing policy, not from here. Kept so this route is not changed by saving.

pricing.unconvertible: Priced in {{code}}, which has no conversion rate — this model's spend is missing from {{base}} totals and budgets.

playground.copyAsCodeHint: The same OpenAI SDK, pointed at Rolter. The key is read from an environment variable so the snippet is safe to paste anywhere.

apiBase.doubled: This base ends in /v1 and rolter appends /v1 itself, so requests would 404. Remove the trailing /v1.
apiBase.excludesV1: Leave off the version prefix — rolter appends /v1 itself for {{kind}}
apiBase.includesV1: Include the version prefix — {{kind}} expects it in the base, e.g. https://api.example.com/v1

openMode.title: Self-service keys need a local account.
openMode.body: This control plane is running in open mode with no admin token, so it has no user accounts — there is no "you" to mint a key for. Set ROLTER_ADMIN_TOKEN and create a local account to use this screen, or manage keys from the admin Virtual Keys screen instead.
